decision.question: Should we halt ALL internal infrastructure development for 2 weeks to force a 'Sales Blitz'?
decision.recommendation: Yes. We have built a world-class operating system (Kira/Memory/Apollo) but have no revenue to sustain it. A 14-day total focus on outreach is required to break the 'infrastructure trap'.
evidence: Current MRR: $300 (Target: $700 by end of March)
February revenue goal was missed due to infra focus
Kira infrastructure is now mature enough (200k+ facts) to support high-volume outreach
IAM lead list (60+ chains) and ZenithCred sequences are ready to be fired

options.label: 14-Day Sales Blitz
options.description: 0 hours on code/infra. 100% on OttoGen/IAM/ZenithCred outreach.
